sections.heading: PROFILE
sections.text: Solution Architect and software engineer who designs systems rather than only implementing features. Strongest in translating business requirements into maintainable software: requirements engineering, Domain-Driven Design, event-driven architecture, API and integration design, and balancing maintainability, performance and security. Designed the greenfield architecture for a restaurant point-of-sale system end-to-end (Laravel/PostgreSQL backend, TypeScript frontend, REST APIs). Comfortable bridging business and technology, aligning stakeholders, and reasoning through architecture trade-offs. Currently deepening cloud and infrastructure practice (AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform).

items.title: AI-Assisted Web Development / Software Architecture
bullets: Designed the end-to-end software architecture for a greenfield restaurant point-of-sale (POS) system: layered Laravel/PostgreSQL backend, TypeScript and Alpine.js frontend, and REST APIs for integration
Applied Domain-Driven Design and event-driven patterns to keep the domain model maintainable as requirements evolved
Translated business requirements from executive management and the Product Owner into technical designs, using Gherkin to align on expected behavior before implementation
Made and documented architecture decisions that balance maintainability, performance and security
Set up and maintained GitLab CI/CD pipelines and Docker containerization; established test automation with Codeception and PHPUnit (BDD)
Used AI tools deliberately for architecture exploration, code analysis and automation, keeping engineering judgment in the loop

items.title: Software Development & Project Lead
bullets: Conceived requirements-appropriate software solutions: determined customer needs, derived requirements, and wrote user stories together with the development team and clients
Designed and optimized database systems (setup, planning and structure) for custom web applications
Led and coordinated software projects across web development and programming; reviewed and approved implementations and handed specified tasks to the team
Delivered individual software solutions - new builds as well as adapting and extending existing systems - with quality assurance and analysis of customer business processes

Communicated directly with clients to align technical solutions with business goals; employment reference rates analytical and solution-oriented thinking 'at the highest level' (overall assessment: very good)

items.title: Development & Coordination (Open Source Community Project)
bullets: Analyzed and mapped a historically grown legacy codebase with complex, undocumented dependencies inside a proprietary framework
Extended and debugged the system while preserving its existing architecture
Documented technical processes and the domain (rules, game world) in MediaWiki
Coordinated a ten-person team, aligning technical and organizational work

items.title: Execution Research & Backtesting Platform
bullets: Designed a quantitative research environment to evaluate very large parameter spaces (tens to hundreds of millions of combinations) efficiently instead of naive brute-force loops
Optimized runtime through JIT compilation (Numba), vectorization and algorithmic improvements; built reproducible, modular backtesting and scoring workflows
Demonstrates performance engineering and designing systems that stay usable at scale

items.title: Laravel Pivot Events (Open Source)
bullets: Published an open-source Laravel package that adds pivot (many-to-many) events with custom IDs
Required understanding framework internals and designing a clean, reusable API for other developers
